chapter: Willy Lewis band in Paris and Egypt
title: Big Boy Goudie slaps Willy Lewis; the band debates ousting him
summary: Resentful of pay differences, Big Boy Goudie slapped leader Willy Lewis at Thanksgiving dinner and the band discussed the contract consequences.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Yeah. And he was buying camels and living it up, he and his buddies. So Chitteson, we all got together and were going to get him. They had a boy named Big Boy Goudie. (inaudible), Big Boy would have trouble getting in that door. And Chitteson used to take his money away from him. He was bigger than Chitteson, but he was on his knees shooting crap and he just picked the money up and bass at him: "I don't give you nothing!" And Big Boy said, "But Chitteson, don't take my money away from me." Chitterson walked off. But that was (inaudible) Big Boy just loved Chitterson.
So Big Boy was hearing this and Big Boy was drinking gin, he was saying, "You know, I don't like Egypt, I can't sleep. I

can't sleep at all." And Big Boy had a quart of gin in his hand. And I said, "Well, Big Boy, let me hold that gin for you a moment." And he went upstairs and went to sleep for three days. So I said, that will get you to sleep, Big Boy.
Now, Big Boy heard that Willy was getting all that money and Big Boy was back there -- (panting)

And on Thanksgiving Day they give us a big -- got us a turky and all the trimmings, chestnuts and everything, beautiful. That was for us. We were one of them, then. It seems like Big Boy exploded. Big Boy slapped poor Willy, slap. And Willy had on and the collar just bust all open his full dress and Willy took about five minutes to fall down, down on the floor. And Big Boy picked him up. So he's mad and I said, oh, Big Boy, please -- (unintelligible).
He was holding him up in the air?
Yeah. I said, Big Boy, put him down. Put him down and get him later. But they had to cut on Big Boy and he was crying. It took a long time to get him calmed down.

And then we had a meeting so we decided to put Willy I said, if out and then/ we put him out we had broken the contract. And then, after you do that, he can sue us, too, because it's his band. (Inaudible). Then he give people what they're supposed to have. Everybody's happy. And he give people what they's supposed to have.
